# DistantHorizonsSupportPumpkin

<!-- docs:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Unofficial Distant Horizons server support for Pumpkin
<!-- docs:end summary -->

## Installation

Put `distant-horizons-support-pumpkin.wasm` from the plugin's GitHub release in your server's `plugins/` folder and restart. Hot reload cannot ask for permissions, so the first load needs a restart.

## Permissions

<!-- docs:begin permissions -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Pumpkin asks for these on the server console the first time the plugin loads.

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `http.outbound` | Check Pumpkin Market for plugin updates. |
<!-- docs:end permissions -->

## Attribution and license

This is an unofficial Pumpkin adaptation of the
[Distant Horizons server plugin](https://gitlab.com/distant-horizons-team/distant-horizons-server-plugin),
originally developed by Jim C K Flaten and the upstream contributors. It is not an official
Distant Horizons Team release or endorsed by that team.

Adapted protocol and LOD code retains its upstream copyright notices. This plugin is licensed
under [GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE). The other packages in this repository retain their own licenses.
The initial reference revision is `56a01110579b94c9946130092500c00df7c31925`.

## TODO

- [ ] Generate unexplored terrain and load saved distant chunks when Pumpkin exposes those
  capabilities to plugins. The pinned API (`pumpkin-api-ts` v0.1.1 and Pumpkin
  `0.2.0+26.3-26.51`) only offers `world.get-chunk(x, z)`, which returns already-loaded chunks.
  The upstream plugin delegates loading and generation to Bukkit/Paper, so its implementation
  needs an equivalent Pumpkin API. Requests for unavailable terrain must return an unavailable
  result until plugins can request generation, wait for completion and release chunks afterward.
